gaps.sentence: Insure the camera ___ it gets damaged in transit.
gaps.explanation: 'In case it gets damaged' = as a precaution against damage.

gaps.sentence: The course offers not only theory ___ hands-on fieldwork.
gaps.explanation: 'Not only... but also' is the fixed correlative pair.

gaps.sentence: She has decided to cycle to work ___ taking the bus.
gaps.explanation: 'Instead of + -ing' = in place of the bus journey.

gaps.sentence: ___ feeling nervous, she delivered a flawless presentation.
gaps.explanation: 'In spite of' + -ing expresses concession with a non-finite form.

gaps.sentence: Sales fell sharply last quarter; ___, the board cut the dividend.
gaps.explanation: The fall in sales caused the cut: as a result marks the consequence.

gaps.sentence: He lowered his voice ___ wake the baby.
gaps.explanation: Negative purpose = so as not to / in order not to + infinitive.

gaps.sentence: She earns a very good salary; ___, she never seems to have any money.
gaps.explanation: 'Yet' contrasts two facts, like but, in a slightly more formal way.

gaps.sentence: She took an evening job ___ fund her law degree.
gaps.explanation: 'In order to' + bare infinitive expresses purpose after a noun phrase subject.
